answer: Locks are recorded in voyage, expire in zephyr, and wander lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 14 aliases as a result needs 55 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1660 identities would post 4898 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
